legacy_metadata_note: These 14 successful checkpoints were produced before diagnostic clamp-count logging was added. They passed the removed guard and then executed the identical mean_scaling, AR(1) GLM, contrast, and inverse-variance code path; their sidecars therefore omit only mean_scaling_clamped_voxels diagnostics.
failed_attempts: Initial Slurm array job 38985523 tasks 3, 4, 5, 10, 17, and 18 (sub-004, sub-005, sub-006, sub-013, sub-020, and sub-021) exited under an implementation preflight guard that rejected run/voxel temporal means near zero before Nilearn scaling. No subject checkpoint was written by a failed task. Exact retry jobs 38988452, 38996012, and 38990221 completed all six subjects successfully after the guard was corrected.

A read-only development diagnostic that attempted to hold several full 4D BOLD arrays under the 4 GiB interactive allocation was killed for memory. It wrote no source or result artifact; bounded mask/proxy checks and Slurm-scale retries replaced it.

Pending aggregation jobs 38987807 and 38998260 were canceled before execution: the first had an unsatisfiable afterok dependency once original fit tasks failed, and the second predated integration of the diagnostic-only edge audit. Two attempted mixed dependencies on already-completed retry arrays were rejected by Slurm without creating a job. Final job 38999383 uses afterany on the original array and independently requires exactly 108 valid immutable checkpoints before writing anything.

repairs.reason: The frozen 95-percent coverage mask permits a small number of low-intensity edge voxels in individual runs, while the initial guard inadvertently imposed an unfrozen 100-percent per-run nonzero-mean condition.
repairs.change: Removed only the extra near-zero temporal-mean rejection; retained the finite-value check and delegated scaling exactly to nilearn.glm.first_level.mean_scaling, the implementation used by frozen signal_scaling=0. Added clamp-count logging and sidecar provenance.
repairs.numerical_consistency: Every successful pre-repair task had passed the removed guard and already executed the identical Nilearn mean_scaling, AR(1) GLM, contrasts, and inverse-variance fixed effects. Failed tasks had written no immutable checkpoint, so their exact retries are the only checkpoints for those subjects.
validation: All six exact subject retries completed with finite effects and strictly positive variances.

For the most extensive observed edge case, sub-006 run 1 S0, the float64 logging diagnostic identified 1672 temporal means below 1 and the run completed under unchanged Nilearn mean_scaling; the diagnostic count is not asserted to equal Nilearn's internal float32 comparison in every rounding-edge case.
Frozen contract and common-mask SHA-256 values remained unchanged.
Post-repair Python compilation and aggregate synthetic algebra self-tests passed.
